name: EPIC 248423140
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 9.9 solar radii and 1.06 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,022 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.06 solar masses and 9.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,103 K at its surface.
